## RiskRuleSeverity

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Sdk.RiskRuleSeverity</code>. Kind: `enum`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/RiskContracts.cs:20](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/RiskContracts.cs#L20).

How seriously a rule treats its own findings. This is the single lever that decides admission. The validator maps it to an outcome and no rule can override that mapping per order, so a rule&#x27;s declared severity and its effect can never disagree. Lives here rather than in Meridian.Risk because RiskViolation carries it and Meridian.Execution&#x27;s RiskValidationResult exposes those violations. Meridian.Risk references Meridian.Execution, so the reverse reference would be a project cycle.

```csharp
public enum RiskRuleSeverity
```
